_comment: Copy to cluster.json and edit. No passwords in here: the scripts ask for the root password, or read SPORK_PASSWORD.
_client_comment: Where the client scripts (create_schema.py, record_io.py) send requests. Leave out to use http://<host>:<http_port> for every node. Set it when the client server reaches the nodes through an SSH tunnel, e.g. ["http://127.0.0.1:12480", "http://127.0.0.1:12481", "http://127.0.0.1:12482"].
